sentences.en: Looking at his email address, would you say he's American?
sentences.zh: 看他的邮箱地址，你觉得他是美国人吗？

sentences.en: You can't just answer emails from people you don't know.
sentences.zh: 你不能随便回复不认识的人发来的邮件。

sentences.en: I never answer email messages from people I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不给不认识的人回邮件。
